messages:
Maya (Support): FYI — Acme Corp reported a complicated billing issue. Their card declined on the renewal and they asked for an invoice with a PO number. They also downgraded mid-cycle (Pro -> Standard) yesterday and want the proration credit applied. INV-2025-0345 is the current invoice.

Liam (Finance): Thanks. Do we know whether INV-2025-0345 was actually charged or is it pending? If card declined, might be unpaid.

Maya (Support): Payment attempt shows decline (code: card_declined). The UI still lists invoice as 'unpaid'. Customer provided PO PO-8742 and says they need the invoice reissued with the PO and correct VAT.

Raj (Account Manager): They also sent a VAT ID (GB999999973). They say they are VAT-registered in the UK and expect reverse charge / no VAT on our invoice.

Liam (Finance): Okay: two separate things: 1) unpaid invoice because card declined — customer will either update card or pay by wire; 2) proration for downgrade — we need to calculate credit note and apply it to balance or refund if they already paid. Since payment didn't go through, we should just reissue a corrected invoice showing PO and VAT handling and apply the proration credit against it.

Maya (Support): Customer prefers a credit note and a reduced invoice they can approve and send to AP. They asked for a short breakdown of how you computed the proration.

Liam (Finance): I'll prepare the numbers. Quick recap of dates: billing period 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-28 (monthly), downgrade effective 2025-02-10. Pro price = $1,200/mo, Standard = $800/mo. Remaining days after downgrade = 18 (10th through 27th inclusive? we should standardize). We use pro-rated credit = (old_price - new_price) * (remaining_days / total_days). For Feb (28 days): (1200-800)*(18/28) = 400*(0.642857) = $257.14. Rounding rules: round to nearest cent.

Maya (Support): Can you put that in a one-line formula I can paste for the customer?

Liam (Finance): Sure. Paste: ```Proration credit = (Old plan price - New plan price) * (Remaining days / Billing period days) = (1200 - 800) * (18 / 28) = $257.14 (rounded).```

Raj (Account Manager): VAT note: Because they provided a UK VAT ID and are B2B, we should apply reverse charge (no VAT on our invoice). Please include their VAT ID and wording: 'VAT reverse-charged, customer responsible for local VAT.' Also include PO-8742 in header.

billing-bot: Auto-note: Credit note template CN-2025-078 created (draft).

Liam (Finance): Action plan I suggest: 1) Reissue INV-2025-0345 as INV-2025-0345-R1 with PO-8742 and VAT reverse charge language; 2) Attach draft credit note CN-2025-078 for $257.14 net; 3) Since original card declined, don't process refund — apply credit against the reissued invoice. If customer then pays by card or wire, remaining balance = invoice_total - credit. If they want an actual refund later, we'll process after payment settles.

Maya (Support): Customer asked: "If we pay by PO/wire today, how long until service resumes?" (they were downgraded but some features disabled).

Raj (Account Manager): After we receive payment and mark invoice paid it should be immediate. If they pay by wire, include their wire reference on the payment so we can reconcile faster.

Liam (Finance): I'll reissue the invoice now and send to Maya to forward. Also will set billing flags so system doesn't auto-cancel for 48h to allow wire.

Maya (Support): Thanks. I sent them a message with the proration formula and told them we'll get the reissued invoice shortly. I'll update thread when they confirm wire or card update. :thumbsup:

Liam (Finance): Done — INV-2025-0345-R1 and CN-2025-078 (draft) attached to the customer ticket. Notes: credit note net = $257.14, VAT = 0 (reverse charge), PO on invoice header.

Maya (Support): Customer confirmed they'll wire today and will send remittance with PO-8742. Closing loop once payment posts.

Liam (Finance): If payment posts and there's any rounding residual (cents), we'll absorb it or issue a micro-adjustment.

Raj (Account Manager): Thanks team. Filing follow-up: if they later ask for an actual refund instead of credit application, we follow the standard refund policy and issue a payment refund referencing CN-2025-078.

Maya (Support): Closing for now — will reopen if any hiccups.
